descriptions.d19d_select_nearest_enemy_80158bb0: Turn-control handler: when idle and the game phase (0x80023128) is at most 2, find the active worm of another, non-allied team nearest to the message position within 300 units (squared distance <= 90000) and post its index and team, then post the current worm's index and team. Owns its 90000.0 float literal.
